Work that sits alongside the dissertation: analyses, datasets, and tools that
are useful on their own.

## Smallmouth Bass × crayfish predation

![](assets/images/lab/predator-prey-tank-system.jpg){fig-alt="A rack of blue opaque experimental tanks used for predator-prey trials." width="45%"}

Laboratory predator–prey trials quantifying how Smallmouth Bass select
between native Signal Crayfish and non-native Ringed Crayfish. Feeds
[Chapter 2](research.qmd#laboratory-predatorprey-trials-smallmouth-bass-and-crayfish).

*Status: pilot-phase trials underway to finalize the protocol.*

## Crayfish thermal preference

![](assets/images/lab/thermal-preference-apparatus.jpg){fig-alt="Overhead photo of the empty two-channel thermal-choice tank." width="45%"}

Thermal-choice trials comparing short-term behavioral response to a warm/cool
input between Signal and Ringed Crayfish. Feeds
[Chapter 3](research.qmd#thermal-preference-and-shelter-competition-between-native-and-non-native-crayfish).

*Status: pilot trials active (13 of a planned 30–36 completed).*

## Native–non-native crayfish competition

![](assets/figures/ch3-competition-design.svg){fig-alt="Diagram of the planned 2 by 2 factorial shelter-competition design, marked as not yet started." width="45%"}

Planned interspecific shelter-competition experiment testing how temperature
changes dominance and displacement between the two species. Feeds
[Chapter 3](research.qmd#thermal-preference-and-shelter-competition-between-native-and-non-native-crayfish).

*Status: design complete; no trials conducted yet.*

## Umpqua River field sampling

![](assets/images/field/abdullah-crayfish-sampling-river.jpg){fig-alt="A researcher wearing waders in a river, examining a mesh trap over a sorting tray." width="45%"}

Diet, crayfish availability, and thermal habitat sampling across the Umpqua
River basin, pairing Bass Bash stomach collections with standardized crayfish
trapping. Feeds
[Chapter 1](research.qmd#trophic-ecology-of-smallmouth-bass-in-two-oregon-rivers).

*Status: sample collection ongoing; species-level processing underway.*

## Saudi fisheries and marine trophic analyses

Analyses of Saudi national fisheries statistics and marine trophic structure,
aimed at describing production trends and their implications for marine
resource management and the Blue Economy. See [Publications](publications.qmd)
for the associated manuscript.

## Citizen science and freshwater invertebrates in Saudi Arabia

Using citizen-science records to identify potential aquarium-release hotspots
for non-native aquatic organisms in Riyadh's urban lakes. See
[Publications](publications.qmd).

## Reproducible analysis workflows

R and Quarto pipelines that take raw field data through models, figures, and
tables to a rendered document, so an analysis can be rerun end to end. See
[Data & Code](data-code.qmd).

*Status: ongoing.*

## Interactive research framework

A browser-based framework illustrating the bass–crayfish interaction system
studied in this dissertation.

[View the framework](https://behes2024.github.io/bass-crayfish-framework/)
